# Breadcrumbs

A trail of the levels above the current view, for drill-downs (Library › Bicep › Glue) and the mobile explorer's navigation trail, with each link in its destin…

`SongNodes.Breadcrumbs` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.Breadcrumbs items={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.Breadcrumbs" items="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (BreadcrumbsProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | Accessible name: "Breadcrumb" or "Navigation trail". |
| `items` * | `{ label: string; href?: string; module: ModuleKey; icon?: boolean }[]` | Levels from the top; the last one is the current page and is not a link. |
| `variant` | `"default" \| "trail"` | Trail style for the mobile explorer, with a visible caption. |
| `maxVisible` | `number` | Collapse the middle when there are more levels than this (default 4). |
